_hinweis: Texts on the topic of integration. The assistant manager writes to the manager (informal). Placeholders: {spieler}, {spieler_kurz}.

standard: {spieler} has settled in. He knows the routines, talks on the pitch and no longer sits alone at mealtimes. There's nothing more for me to do there.
Quick update on {spieler_kurz}: the squad has taken to him. He's playing regularly and the understanding with the players around him works. We can tick that transfer off.
{spieler} has barely featured since the move. He trains well but keeps himself to himself. If we do nothing, we'll lose him before he's even properly here.
We should talk about {spieler_kurz}. He has hardly been on the pitch since he arrived and hasn't found his place in the dressing room yet.
He'll get his games over the coming weeks. Prepare him for it.
Pair him with an experienced player. He has to earn the games himself.
He has to fight his way through like everyone else. We change nothing.
Will do. I'll tell him his chance is coming. But then it has to actually come.
Good idea, I'll ask one of the older lads. It'll help him in the dressing room; it doesn't change anything on the bench for now.
Your decision. I'll keep an eye on him and let you know if it tips.
